tracks.title: A Spoonful Of Bromide Helps The Pulse Rate Go Down

verdict.detail: Discogs lists 2 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

physical: Pressed by The Gramophone Co. Ltd.

notes.text:
Catalogue numbers:
PEG 1 on back and spine of sleeve
PEG-1 on labels

Tracks A1, A3, B1 and B4 published by Essex International / G.H. Music Ltd.
Tracks A2 and B2 published by G.H. Music Ltd.
Tracks A4 and B3 published by Essex International

Printed and made by E. J. Day Group, London and Bedford

℗ 1971

Track titles of both A-side and B-side appear on the B-side label. A-side label has the 'Pegasus' logo (see images)

Month of release information from Record Collector Magazine Aug 1993 p.106

Runouts are stamped except '3' in variant 2 on B-side is etched
